source: jdx/fnox v1.39.0 + packages/wasi-fnox/NNNN-*.patch (apply.sh); each patch maps to cert cases below
certPending: KS-2 is released in slicc-kernel 1.68.0 (not certified yet: next kernel delta cert); test/sealed.mjs runs against it with a vault double
KS-8: materialize tickets checked at exec (path, sha256 of argv, cwd, parent pid; one-shot, 30 s)
a vault behind the device (or the kernel's test double) answering the §3.7 ops
checklist: fnox --version → fnox 1.39.0; --help lists exec/get/set/proxy and no daemon, tui, mcp; provider add --help offers sealed
with /etc/fnox/config.toml (default_provider seven, type sealed) via FNOX_CONFIG_DIR: get, export and env print the stored placeholder; no device needed
discovery from a subdirectory of the project (cwd from PWD)
without /dev/sealed: set from a pipe, exec with a sealed secret and check --all fail with exactly `not running in seven: /dev/sealed is missing`
set NAME value (a value on the command line) is refused for a sealed secret; --key-name is refused
age: set --provider age encrypts to the recipients (ciphertext in fnox.toml, no plaintext); get fails with exactly `age secrets aren't supported in seven yet (slicc-vault#2)`
sync and reencrypt refused with `not available in seven: the value would be in a program (use a header rule)`
proxy rules --json prints the [proxy] rules; proxy run -- printenv shows each rule's env name holding the placeholder and the secret's own name unset
exec with only plain secrets: the child gets the value, stderr warns that it was passed as a plain value; exec of a missing command exits 127
exec --shell-grants without /dev/sealed fails with `not running in seven: /dev/sealed is missing`
test/sealed.mjs (KS-2, vault double): set from a pipe → seal {name, value} → placeholder stored, value not in fnox.toml, stdout, stderr or /proc/<pid>/cmdline

test/sealed.mjs (KS-2, vault double): set on a terminal → request {kind: value} → status polled → placeholder stored; ^C sends cancel and exits 130; ^C during a 10 s machine wait cancels after the reply
test/sealed.mjs (KS-2, vault double): check → placeholder {name}: removed records and unknown placeholders are errors, inert records warnings

PENDING (KS-2 + KS-8): exec -- printenv with a sealed secret → materialize {names, path, argv (argv[0] = resolved path), cwd} → SLICC_SEALED_TICKET → the child sees the value for real:true names and the placeholder for real:false ones; fnox's own stdout/stderr never carry the value

PENDING (KS-8, exposure): what the child and its environment expose: /proc/<child>/cmdline and status, the child's own children (inherited env), ps as another user, a reused or mismatched ticket (argv, cwd, path, parent) failing closed with EACCES

PENDING (users enforce in a seven-like setup: bios K4 branch #355; sudo and tags are in slicc-kernel 1.66.0): /etc/fnox/config.toml root-owned 0644: a non-root user reads and resolves it, fnox set or edit fails with EACCES, sudo succeeds

PENDING (KS-2 + KS-8): exec --shell-grants -- /bin/bash -c CMD → materialize {shellGrants: true, path, argv, cwd} (no names) → each granted name set to its placeholder (from the config or `placeholder {name}`) → the child bash sees the real value; the config's other sealed secrets keep placeholders

PENDING (KS-8, interpreter chain): fnox never claims `interpreter`; an npm-style `#!/usr/bin/env node` script (chain reported as the resolved node) gets real values under an `[exec] { argv }` rule when the kernel reports it trusted (root-owned, non-writable script, chain and parents), is refused when untrusted, and is refused under `[exec] = true`; `#!/usr/bin/env` with options or assignments stays refused

patches.0002-providers-build-only-age-and-plain-: age set encrypts; provider types outside the allowlist fail when used
patches.0003-cli-compile-out-modules-that-cannot: --help lists no daemon, tui or mcp
patches.0004-wasi-take-the-working-directory-and: get from a subdirectory of the project (cwd from PWD)
patches.0005-wasi-spawn-fnox-exec-children-throu: plain exec: the child runs and gets the value
patches.0006-providers-add-the-sealed-provider-f: get/export print the stored placeholder; the missing-device error; test/sealed.mjs: seal, rotation, placeholder {name}, the caller stamp
patches.0007-set-seal-piped-values-and-ask-seven: set refuses argv values and --key-name; test/sealed.mjs: seal from a pipe, request/status/cancel on a terminal, EAGAIN
patches.0008-exec-let-seven-s-kernel-hand-sealed: exec with a sealed secret needs the device; missing command → 127; plain warning; test/sealed.mjs: the materialize request (values: PENDING KS-8)
patches.0009-proxy-rules-json-and-proxy-run-with: proxy rules --json; proxy run gives the placeholder and scrubs the secret's name
patches.0010-seven-refuse-what-would-put-a-value: sync/reencrypt refused; age get fails with slicc-vault#2; test/sealed.mjs: check --all on inert, removed, rotated and missing records
patches.0011-wasi-allow-the-lints-that-code-comp: lint-only: the WASI build has no warnings (no runtime case)
patches.0012-feat-proxy-take-rule-secrets-from-l: host-only (fnox-build test/proxy_lease.bats); on WASI, proxy run still passes placeholders
patches.0013-fix-lease-run-command-leases-throug: host-only (Windows; fnox-build); leases are not in the WASI build
patches.0014-providers-offer-the-sealed-provider: provider add --help offers sealed on WASI
patches.0015-exec-shell-grants-and-run-the-child: exec --shell-grants without the device fails; test/sealed.mjs: materialize {shellGrants} with no names (values: PENDING KS-8)
